changed:
Refused driver steps fail closed and never strand a run; phase review P-1, P-3 and P-5.
- Reads: the gateway returns a fixed refusal to the driver before any provider call, in off and on. The codes are CONNECTION_NOT_AVAILABLE, READ_NOT_PERMITTED, UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY and NOT_A_READ_CAPABILITY. No message names a role, credential, subject or policy detail, and a policy refusal never reaches the provider. A driver that keeps asking ends FAILED BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.
- Answers and proposals: an answer on an unusable connection is the KERNEL-CONNECTION repair finding. An answer with no verifier ends FAILED VERIFICATION_FAILED with KERNEL-VERIFIER. A proposal of an unknown kind is the KERNEL-PROPOSAL-KIND repair finding. The worker path no longer classifies these as INTERRUPTED.
- P-3: before every plan step reserves, the plan digest is recomputed from the step inputs and compared with approval.action_digest. A mismatch, or a multi-step action without its plan state, blocks the step and fails the run STALE with KERNEL-PLAN-DIGEST-MISMATCH. A 1-step on plan passes.
- P-5: the resume comments follow the ADR 0025 amendment.
- Kernel reads (verifier, revalidation) keep their codes and messages; the recorded exception class on those failure paths is now ReadRefused.
open_items: Review R-1 (pre-existing, provider-caused): a provider read returning a mismatched observation raises FORBIDDEN out of _driver_read. The run is left until recovery, or ends INTERRUPTED in the worker. A follow-up for a later phase.
The worker-path test covers the connection read and the answer; the other refusal causes rely on the kernel liveness test (same _drive path).
P-3 adds one get_plan read per plan step dispatch (on only).
Codex final check of 2c.8b and 2c.8c after the usage limit resets (23:11).

rulings.ruling: Phase review P-1, P-3 and P-5, and the other stranding read and proposal causes, were folded into 2c.8c so that Codex reviews one complete fix.
A refused read is a fixed refusal to the driver (the model may recover within its budget), not an immediate run failure.
The change of the recorded exception class name on the kernel-read failure path is accepted.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: A consumer matching the class name; none exists.

outside_repo.change: gate pg and the Postgres suites ran against e_agent_test in e-agent-ledger.
